_sources: provisions: 1961 s.244A / 2025 s.437 (coverage MODELLED by INT-REFUND); interest on an excess refund (s.234D / s.426) is out of scope; plans/W-112b.md; D-663
summary: Interest the Government adds to a refund, by the month from when the tax was paid or the return furnished until the refund is granted, unless the refund is small beside the tax.

routes.name: Interest added to a refund
routes.description: Paid with the refund; not part of what is owed.
